claims.quote: the Scottish Government is one of the most centralised devolved administrations in Europe
claims.statement: The Scottish Government is one of the most centralised devolved administrations in Europe.

claims.quote: the next stage of devolution should place more decision-making in the hands of Scotland’s regions and cities to drive reindustrialisation
claims.statement: The next stage of devolution should place more decision-making in the hands of Scotland’s regions and cities to drive reindustrialisation.

claims.quote: Through No10 North, we are rewiring the state
claims.statement: The UK Government is rewiring the state through No10 North.

claims.quote: With us working together, there is no limit to what we can achieve for the Scottish people.
claims.statement: Working together, the UK and Scottish Governments can achieve no limit to what they achieve for the Scottish people.

claims.quote: People in North Lanarkshire, in Fife or in the Highlands know what their communities need better than any minister, whether they sit in London or Edinburgh.
claims.statement: People in North Lanarkshire, Fife and the Highlands know what their communities need better than any minister, whether in London or Edinburgh.

claims.quote: The Prime Minister’s offer to the Scottish Government is a genuine one, and the Scotland Office is ready to roll up its sleeves alongside them to make it happen.
claims.statement: The Prime Minister’s offer to the Scottish Government is genuine, and the Scotland Office is ready to work alongside the Scottish Government to make it happen.

claims.quote: Two governments, one goal - good jobs and real opportunity in every corner of Scotland.
claims.statement: The UK and Scottish Governments share one goal: good jobs and real opportunity in every corner of Scotland.

facts.quote: Delivering his remarks after speaking with young people today in Lanarkshire
facts.statement: Andy Burnham spoke with young people in Lanarkshire on 2026-10-15.

facts.quote: During my first week in office, I told the First Minister that I wanted to work with him to spread opportunities to communities across Scotland’s regions and cities.
facts.statement: Andy Burnham told the First Minister in his first week in office that he wanted to work with him to spread opportunities across Scotland’s regions and cities.

facts.quote: This is me making an offer to the Scottish Government.
facts.statement: Andy Burnham made an offer to the Scottish Government to work together on regional empowerment.

facts.quote: despite significant devolution from Westminster over the last 27 years
facts.statement: There has been significant devolution from Westminster to Holyrood over the last 27 years.
